properties.name: easy-extension.allow-unknown-business
properties.description: 是否允许未知业务，当没有业务身份可以匹配时，如果不允许未知业务则请求报错，如果允许，则扩展点会走默认能力兜底。只在没有配置 unknown-business-policy / multi-match-policy 时生效：false 等于两者都是 reject，true 等于 default + select。 whether to allow unknown business. when there is no business to match, if not allowed, the request will report an error. If allowed, the extension point will use the default ability. Only used for the policies that are not set explicitly: false means both are reject, true means default and select.

properties.name: easy-extension.unknown-business-policy
properties.description: 没有任何业务匹配时怎么办：reject 请求报错（no business matched），default 走默认实现兜底。不配置时跟随 allow-unknown-business。 what to do when no business matches: reject fails the request (no business matched), default serves it with the default implementations. When not set, follows allow-unknown-business.

properties.name: easy-extension.multi-match-policy
properties.description: 多个业务同时匹配时怎么办：reject 请求报错（multiple business found），select 由 business-match-order / BusinessMatchSelector 选一个（并打印一次 WARN）。不配置时跟随 allow-unknown-business。 what to do when several businesses match: reject fails the request (multiple business found), select lets business-match-order / BusinessMatchSelector pick one (and logs a WARN once per combination). When not set, follows allow-unknown-business.

properties.name: easy-extension.enable-log
properties.description: 是否启用日志，扩展点匹配过程会打印相应的日志 whether to enable logs, the extension point matching process will print log

properties.name: easy-extension.enable-session-auto-cleanup
properties.description: 是否启用Session自动清理过滤器 whether to enable the session auto cleanup filter, which automatically cleans up session data in ThreadLocal after the web request ends to prevent memory leaks

properties.name: easy-extension.business-match-order
properties.description: 业务匹配优先级顺序（使用业务 code）。当多个业务同时匹配时，按此顺序选择优先级最高的。未列出的按注册顺序排在末尾。
